name: Action Item Tracker
description: Metabase dashboard for Action Item Tracker

native.query: SELECT title, assignee_id, due_date, meeting_id FROM mtg_action_items WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY due_date
SELECT assignee_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN status='DONE' THEN 1 END)*100/COUNT(*) as completion_pct FROM mtg_action_items WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY assignee_id ORDER BY completion_pct DESC
